about: Postcommunion for the commemoration of Saint Petronilla.

seg.tr: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; always refresh us, we beseech You, through the intercession of her whose solemnity we celebrate.

a.g: always, we beseech You, by her intercession

seg.tr: Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w032: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
